bead.title: Expose typed pqueue index query API
bead.description: Update pqueue's query surface so callers query typed ESF indexes without raw Vec<Vec<u8>> escape hatches. Keep pqueue name-based query identity from QueueIndex.name. In-scope files: crates/pqueue/src/lib.rs, crates/pqueue-engine/src/port.rs, crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs, tests. Add typed query methods accepting serde_json::Value values or a small typed key wrapper; deprecate or internally adapt old raw byte query methods only for legacy indexes if necessary. Ensure unique/non-unique query APIs use axon_esf encoding and validate arity/type errors. Out-of-scope: SQL implementation for relational backends.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue secondary_indexes -- --nocapture passes; cargo test -p pqueue encapsulation -- --nocapture passes; tests prove raw byte lookup cannot bypass typed index validation for typed queues and name-based queries still resolve the configured QueueIndex.name.
